items.title: 2026-10-17 ★ Hospital Flow Optimizer - [[ -- NEW MOD -- ]]
items.text:
→ Smarter doctor, room and laboratory workload distribution.

items.title: 2026-10-22 ★ HFO/HPO/HTC/HSH - Update
items.text:
→ HFO, HPO, HTC and HSH received a performance optimization pass.
→ Update recommended for smoother performance, especially in large or busy hospitals.
→ Their latest fixes and gameplay improvements are included too.

items.title: 2026-10-22 ★ HPO - Fixes
items.text:
→ More reliable Porter recognition and hiring.
→ Corrected hospitalization UI layout.
→ Improved chained patient transport and male Sample Cart animation.

items.title: 2026-10-25 ★ Hospital Runtime Optimizer - [[ -- NEW MOD -- ]]
items.text:
→ Boosts performance by reducing redundant game and rendering work.
→ Measured up to +27.8% FPS on the reference hospital test.
→ Keeps normal simulation, pathfinding and gameplay decisions unchanged.
